mintAuthority.summary: sDOLA is an ERC-4626 savings wrapper over DOLA; wrapper minting is deposit/share accounting while durable DOLA mint authority is inherited from reviewed parent DOLA.

controls.label: sDOLA ERC-4626 wrapper
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25534205, asset() returned DOLA 0x865377367054516e17014CcdED1e7d814EDC9ce4, gov() returned Timelock 0x926df14a23be491164dcf93f4c468a50ef659d5b, and operator() was zero. The EIP-1967 implementation and admin slots were zero. Verified source shows immutable constructor wiring; gov can set the operator or governance and sweep ERC-20 tokens other than DBR, but cannot change deployed share-accounting logic. The wrapper cannot mint DOLA; durable DOLA mint authority remains inherited from the reviewed parent.

review.evidence: The existing July 15 pinned implementation review establishes the immutable sDOLA ERC-4626 accounting over DOLA and is not re-dated as a new chain observation. On October 3, 2026, the issuer disclaimer expressly describes Inverse as a decentralized open-source protocol not affiliated with any central authority or organization, provides products as-is, and places risk on users. The organization page identifies DAO/working-group oversight, not prudential or independent financial-attestation oversight of the local sDOLA share issuance. Local supervision is therefore reviewed none; parent DOLA issuance risk remains inherited.
